vehicleworks.opt.heading: Heading Indicator
vehicleworks.pa.text.0: Welcome aboard. Please find your seat and place your bags in the overhead bins.
vehicleworks.pa.text.1: Ladies and gentlemen, the doors are closed. Please fasten your seat belts and switch your devices to flight mode.
vehicleworks.pa.text.2: Please pay attention to the safety demonstration. Emergency exits are located at the front and rear of the cabin.
vehicleworks.pa.text.4: We have reached our cruising altitude. You may now use the entertainment system. Please keep your seat belt fastened while seated.
vehicleworks.pa.text.5: We are starting our descent. Please return to your seats, raise your seat backs and stow your tray tables.
vehicleworks.pa.text.6: Welcome to your destination. Please remain seated until the seat belt sign is switched off.
vehicleworks.pa.text.7: You may now leave the aircraft. Thank you for flying with us.

vehicleworks.panel.none: This vehicle has no Cockpit Panel

vehicleworks.start.no_bus: Battery on, but the MASTER switch is off: no power on the bus
vehicleworks.start.no_power: No electrical power: turn the BATTERY on
vehicleworks.start.no_pump: Turn the FUEL PUMP on first
vehicleworks.tooltip.aircraft_door: Passenger or cargo door, two blocks high. Opens outward and slides; locked in flight.
vehicleworks.tooltip.aircraft_light: Navigation, beacon, strobe, landing, taxi, turn-off or cockpit light. Choose the type with right-click; faces where you look.
vehicleworks.tooltip.airliner_engine: Under-wing turbofan: nacelle, spinning fan and spinner, exhaust cone and pylon, all in one block.
vehicleworks.tooltip.ammo_box: Stores ammunition that weapons reload from.
vehicleworks.tooltip.ballast_tank: Flood (Sprint) to dive, blow (Jump) to surface.
vehicleworks.tooltip.balloon_envelope: Light fabric. Enclosed space becomes lifting gas (hot air with a burner, helium without).
vehicleworks.tooltip.bogie_gear: Four-tyre bogie (two axles) for heavy aircraft. Rated 90 t per leg, strong brakes.
vehicleworks.tooltip.burner: Heats the air in envelopes (Jump). Uses fuel.
vehicleworks.tooltip.canard_wing: Small all-moving foreplane (pitch control); stalls before the main wing.
vehicleworks.tooltip.center_pedestal: Thrust levers, engine masters, speed brake, flaps, gear lever, parking brake and two MCDUs.
vehicleworks.tooltip.cockpit_panel: Switch panel: battery, lights, engines, gear, emergency test, autopilot. Mount it on the ceiling. While seated, right-click a button on it directly, or press X.
vehicleworks.tooltip.copilot_seat: Flight crew seat: cockpit access and HUD, the captain flies.
vehicleworks.tooltip.crew_panel: Cabin lights, seat belt sign, announcements, door status, call lights and interphone.
vehicleworks.tooltip.delta_wing: Delta planform with vortex lift and late stall. Acts as elevons.
vehicleworks.tooltip.double_delta_wing: Strake + delta: strong vortex lift and a very high stall angle.
vehicleworks.tooltip.dual_wheel_gear: Two tyres side by side for larger aircraft. Rated 35 t per leg.
vehicleworks.tooltip.electric_motor: Silent shaft motor that also works under water.
vehicleworks.tooltip.elevator: Pitch control surface (also canards and dive planes).
vehicleworks.tooltip.elliptical_wing: Lowest induced drag, but the whole span stalls at once.
vehicleworks.tooltip.fairing_cone: Smooth nose radome or upswept tail cone in front of / behind the block, sized by its settings.
vehicleworks.tooltip.fcu_panel: Glareshield panel: SPD / HDG / ALT / V/S windows and knobs, AP1 and A/THR.
vehicleworks.tooltip.flap: Extra lift for take-off and landing.
vehicleworks.tooltip.flying_wing: Tailless all-wing section: very low drag, high efficiency. Use elevons at the trailing edge.
vehicleworks.tooltip.forward_swept_wing: Root stalls first: ailerons keep working, agile, docile stall.
vehicleworks.tooltip.fuel_pump: Raises fuel flow so big engines are not starved.
vehicleworks.tooltip.fuel_tank: Holds 300 kg of fuel. Right-click with fuel canisters (sneak to use the whole stack).
vehicleworks.tooltip.galley: Cabinets, oven and coffee maker. Right-click to open the doors / start the oven / brew coffee.
vehicleworks.tooltip.gas_cell: A cell of helium that lifts on its own.
vehicleworks.tooltip.heavy_landing_gear: Huge retractable gear (5x a normal gear) for big aircraft.
vehicleworks.tooltip.high_wing: Mounted above the fuselage: strong roll stability, forgiving, more lift.
vehicleworks.tooltip.hydraulic_pump: Full authority and speed for control surfaces and landing gear.
vehicleworks.tooltip.instrument_panel_a: Six small instrument slots. Right-click to choose the gauges.
vehicleworks.tooltip.instrument_panel_b: Two small gauges and one large screen.
vehicleworks.tooltip.instrument_panel_c: One large display: navigation, radar, flight director, PFD or engines.
vehicleworks.tooltip.instrument_panel_d: Two large displays side by side: primary flight display and navigation display.
vehicleworks.tooltip.instrument_panel_e: Two large displays stacked: engine / warning display and system display.
vehicleworks.tooltip.jet_engine: High thrust with afterburner (hold Sprint at full throttle). Needs an Engine Starter.
vehicleworks.tooltip.jumpseat: Fold-down attendant seat with a four-point harness. Sit: crew controls (X) and announcements (K).
vehicleworks.tooltip.lavatory: Toilet, sink, mirror, soap and light, lockable door with an OCCUPIED sign.
vehicleworks.tooltip.low_wing: Mounted under the fuselage: strong ground effect, agile roll.
vehicleworks.tooltip.main_rotor: Helicopter rotor driven by shaft engines. Keep it above the centre of mass.
vehicleworks.tooltip.marine_propeller: Ship screw; place next to an engine, below the waterline.
vehicleworks.tooltip.missile_launcher: Fictional guided missiles that track the target near your aim.
vehicleworks.tooltip.navigation_computer: Set a waypoint; bearing and distance appear on the HUD.
vehicleworks.tooltip.passenger_seat: Extra seat. Can be configured as a gunner seat for turrets.
vehicleworks.tooltip.performance_gear: Narrow low-drag tyres rated to 500 km/h, fast retraction. Bad on rough ground.
vehicleworks.tooltip.pilot_seat: Sit here to drive or fly the vehicle.
vehicleworks.tooltip.piston_engine: Shaft power. Drives a propeller in front/behind it, the wheels, or a rotor.
vehicleworks.tooltip.propeller: Place directly in front of or behind an engine. Thrust follows the engine facing.
vehicleworks.tooltip.refuel_port: Right-click to refuel the aircraft: choose AVGAS or JET-A and the amount.
vehicleworks.tooltip.reinforced_gear: Stiff, long-travel gear that absorbs hard landings. Rated 55 t per leg.
vehicleworks.tooltip.remote_control_unit: Link weapons (sneak+wrench) and assign each a fire key.
vehicleworks.tooltip.rudder: Yaw control surface; works in air and water.
vehicleworks.tooltip.seat_business: Lie-flat seat, large screen, leg rest, work table, side console.
vehicleworks.tooltip.seat_economy: Headrest, armrests, seat belt, fold-down tray, slight recline.
vehicleworks.tooltip.seat_economy_plus: Wider seat, more legroom, foot rest, adjustable position.
vehicleworks.tooltip.seat_first: Private 2 x 2 suite: bed, sliding door, large screen, table and private lighting.
vehicleworks.tooltip.seat_premium: Leg rest, adjustable headrest, personal entertainment screen, seat controls.
vehicleworks.tooltip.sidestick: Airbus-style side stick. Stick deflection commands pitch and roll rate; centred = attitude hold.
vehicleworks.tooltip.straight_wing: High lift, low speed straight planform.
vehicleworks.tooltip.tail_rotor: Counters main rotor torque; points sideways at the tail.
vehicleworks.tooltip.tapered_wing: Near-elliptic efficiency, light and low drag.
vehicleworks.tooltip.trolley: Right-click to push it along the aisle.
vehicleworks.tooltip.tundra_gear: Big soft balloon tyres: rough-field landings on grass, dirt, sand and snow. Light aircraft only (6 t), max 200 km/h.
vehicleworks.tooltip.turbofan_engine: Efficient jet thrust. Needs an Engine Starter.
vehicleworks.tooltip.turboprop_engine: Powerful shaft turbine. Needs an Engine Starter.
vehicleworks.tooltip.turret_base: Weapons on it aim where the gunner (or pilot) looks.
vehicleworks.tooltip.vehicle_core: Heart of every vehicle: defines the front. Right-click to assemble all connected blocks.
vehicleworks.tooltip.weapon_mount: Weapons must touch a mount (or turret base) to work.
vehicleworks.tooltip.wheel: Suspension wheel with steering, drive and brakes.
vehicleworks.tooltip.wing: Standard wing. Configure lift, airfoil, incidence, sweep and controls with the wrench.
vehicleworks.tooltip.wing_assembly: A whole wing half in one block, sized by its settings: taper, sweep, dihedral, moving flaps, ailerons, slats and spoilers, sharklet and built-in navigation, strobe and landing lights. Can also be a horizontal stabiliser or a vertical fin.
vehicleworks.tooltip.wrench: Use: configure. Sneak-use a weapon to select it, then sneak-use a Remote Control Unit to link.
vehicleworks.tooltip.yoke: Place in front of a seat, facing the pilot. Every yoke moves with the flight controls.
vehicleworks.ui.lift_example: At 50 m/s, 4°: %s N per block, L/D %s
vehicleworks.ui.rcu_empty: No links. Sneak-use a weapon with the wrench, then this unit.
vehicleworks.ui.rcu_hint: Each linked weapon fires on its channel while MASTER ARM is on (B).
